title: National Waterway 23 _Budha Balanga River:
text:
23. National Waterway 23 _Budha Balanga River:_

Barrage (approx 300m from Patalipura village) at Lat
21[o]38‟13”N, Lon 86[o]50‟53”E to confluence of Budha Balanga
river with Bay of Bengal at Chandipur Fishing Port Lat
21[o]28‟12”N, Lon 87[o]04‟12”E.
